{{Top|leg}}
A '''hyperspace jumpzone''', more commonly referred to as a '''hyperspace jump point''', was the point in which [[Starship/Legends|starships]] engaged their [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. This could only be done after programming the jump coordinates into the [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigational computer]]. This was the last point any communications could be sent or received before the hyperdrive engaged. The opposite of this point was a hyperspace [[reversion point]], where ships exited hyperspace and entered [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]]. During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] placed [[mass-shadow mine]]s along the reversion points in the area to prevent [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] reinforcements from arriving.
